notes.title: New Update Out Now! More Bugs, Gliding, and Optimisation
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce a new update to Heist Kitty.

What goes up, must come down, but now you decide how slowly.
We have added a new gliding ability so you can slow your fall in Heist Kitty.
While pressing Ctrl in the air, you will "fluff out" which will help you slow your fall.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41881468/b24b0ed986f7a1447d764e7c62cf0efa6062f079.gif[/img]

Bugs will now spawn when interacting with plants. You can a selection of bugs such as Roaches, Butterflies, Scorpions, plus more. There are a few extra surprises which can appear as well such as trash or even food.

We have also added a "skip tutorial" box in the piano room for those eager to escape the confines of the tutorial apartment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41881468/e44035d8b17f20d1fc484207630af5ddaee5cc7b.png[/img]

We have also adjusted some lighting elements to help further optimise the game.

Thanks,
The Heist Kitty Team

notes.title: Heist Kitty | New Cat Models, Car handling, and optimisations

notes.title: Heist Kitty Cats in Hats Update OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Who doesn't love cats in hats?! We're excited to announce that our latest update is out now! As promised, we have added plenty of hats to Mad Catter's store and Meow Cafe, updated the Harmony Hats store so that you can purchase hats and masks with harmony points (earned by working together with other cats in multiplayer), and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41881468/c07c8ecc11f8722a9605ad9668ec203ed3f3452b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41881468/fae5eda1fef6172e816a9b1fd9d8dfa40745ee98.png[/img]
[i]Meet Stormy. Stormy purchased a hard helmet from the Harmony Hats store! How lovely.[/i]

[h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1]

- Mad Catter Store in the mall is updated and ready for players to buy hats/masks with chaos points and candy. Each hat/mask gives players a special ability while they are wearing the hat/mask.
- The Harmony Hats Store in the city is updated and ready for players to buy hats/masks with harmony points and candy. Each hat/mask gives players a special ability while they are wearing the hat/mask. In order to earn harmony rewards, players must help each other complete tasks in multiplayer such as quests and taking down enemies.
- Stores have been added to Placid beach. One of the new stores is Pacific Hats. This store allows players to buy hats/sunglasses with just candy. Each item in the store gives the players a special ability while wearing the hat.
- Ability to purchase hats added to Meow Cafe
- Bug fixes to the main quest line in the mall and side quest in the city from Roger cat.
- Added an easter egg on Placid Beach to reward players exploring the area and collecting the items. Players must have the diver’s mask to find this easter egg.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41881468/54303120fbf21b7be83999f7bf5cde9af9151c3f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41881468/8e6e2f1d76f10bf1c4c3ee5c8b77b43d616d894a.png[/img]
[i]This is Winter. Winter is very happy with their purchase from the Mad Catter store![/i]

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
Now that this update is shipped, our focus will move onto the October update! You can look forward to the following:

Fast and Furriest update
Racing feature
Racing maps

Thanks,
The Heist Kitty Team

notes.title: Heist Kitty - July Update Out Now! | Achievements, Improved Controller Support
notes.notes:
Hello cats!

We have just launched the July update! As promised, this includes improved controller support, Steam achievements, bug fixes, as well as system and world improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41881468/519759adb4e55a2cfe30d0afce69e1e95f9a1df0.png[/img]

[h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1]

- Updates to controller function in Menus
- Fix for Japanese controller mapping
- Introduced adaptive camera controls for game controller (rotation speeds up when held down)
- Cannon Network added to speed up foot travel around the city
- Added more ambient content to main city (Shops & NPCs)
- Rideable hot air balloon added to Placid Beach
- Steam achievements added
- Updated music on main map to add in new tracks
- Upgraded to Steam SDK 157
- Optimized flow of initial tasks before exiting building
- Changed on-screen notifications to add a delay between messages

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41881468/7190608c18475f1e12da769972a0bca46fe8483c.png[/img]
We've added 32 Steam achievements for you unlock! Happy achievement hunting :)

We hope you enjoy the new and improved world with more shops and NPCs, the improved controller support and the entire update!

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]

We are looking towards the next updates now! As a reminder, here's what we're working on:

[b]August[/b]
Mad Catter's hats
Meow Cafe vanity items
Multiplayer harmony rewards

In August we'll be adding a bunch of new cosmetics for your kitties, making dress up time even more fun! We also look forward to introducing harmony rewards, which will grant you rewards for completing various tasks with others in multiplayer.

[b]October[/b]
Fast and Furriest update
Racing feature
Racing maps

Ready... set... go! We're excited about the October update, which will get you feeling the need for speed! You can look forward to some racing maps and features in October.

We can't wait to get these updates in your hands soon!

Thanks,
The Heist Kitty Team

notes.title: Patch Now Live! | Quest Bug Fixes, Default Controller Layout, More NPCs and More
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41881468/d4b621c1e320d8cc137cecee84a1716c7085053f.jpg[/img]

Thank you all again for a wonderful launch! We have been delighted to see so many of you jump in to our world of cat chaos. We've also been pleased to hear from you all in regards to bug reports, suggestions and feedback and have been reading everything!

We have just dropped the first patch for Heist Kitty, based on your feedback and suggestions! This update fixes some bugs which were blocking some of you from completing quests, adds more human NPCs to make the world feel more alive, increases detail in stores, updates the default controller layout and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41881468/d21ef9019d9a1373eec1b740771afe1b6fb960b2.png[/img]

[h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1]

- Fixed quest 'Animal Control Raid' in Furtasia - when you reload the game with that quest active the enemies will now spawn correctly
- Fixed quest 'Take Down Balloons' in Furtasia - when reloading with that quest active the balloons will now respawn
- Improved optimisation for AI vehicle logic
- Added more NPCs around the city
- Fixed auto-restart for mob waves in Kitty City
- Furnished several stores
- Improved localisation for Japanese
- Default controller layout has been updated so that left stick controls movement only and right stick controls only. If you have already played with a controller you may need to head into the settings and select the default controller layout to access the new default.

Speaking of feedback, your Steam reviews are invaluable not just to us, but for other players discovering more about the game. So please do leave a Steam review if you haven't already!

Over the coming months we have a bunch of features planned, but some of this may change as we get more feedback and suggestions from you.

The currently planned features include:

Mad Catter and Meow Cafe Vanity Items
Multiplayer Harmony Rewards
Full Controller Support
Fast and Furriest update: Racing feature and racing maps

If you want to get a sneak peak at future updates and play an active role in what we work on, please do join our [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/MxNQkZYN66]Discord server[/url][/b].

Meow!~
The Heist Kitty Team

notes.title: New Launch Date: June 14th | Community Alpha Test signups now live!
notes.notes:
Hello all,

Heist Kitty will be launching on June 14th!

For those of you that just can't wait to get your paws on the game, we're launching a Community Alpha Test (C.A.T) - register [b]now[/b] to guarantee a spot as places are limited!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1790360

Head to the storepage, scroll down and request access:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41881468/879e51e8ccd151d5da430ad44d188c437998c559.gif[/img]

[h3]Community Alpha Test (C.A.T)[/h3]

If selected for this playtest, you will receive temporary access to the whole of the game (there may be some [strike]mice[/strike] bugs present - and we'd like your help to find and catch them).
This will be a singleplayer and multiplayer (online) test, so invite your feline friends to play!

We kindly ask that you join our [url=https://discord.gg/87Q8vQ47S5][b]Discord[/b][/url] to report any issues you find with the game, or just to chat to us about what you liked and didn't like!
We're really keen to work with our community and have some extra content updates planned post-launch, so we'd love to hear some feedback from you.

If Discord isn't your thing, we're also active on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1790360/discussions/0/][b]Steam Discussion[/b][/url] forums so feel free to leave some feedback on there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41881468/d92a5f026bedd7a064ef71d6d99620b24c471598.png[/img]

The test will launch on 15th May and will last just over 2 weeks, ending on 30th May when access to the game will be removed. There won't be too much longer to wait until launch though!

Meow!~
The Heist Kitty Team

notes.title: Welcome to Heist Kitty: Cats Go a Stray!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41881468/97e1311a8c61b125fd494ece1f1efbe91b640dd3.jpg[/img]

Hello all,

We're happy to announce a brand new name for our game - Heist Kitty: Cats Go a Stray! This name change comes with some exciting news: we have signed on with indie publisher Excalibur Games.

This partnership will allow us to reach more players, but don't worry! The heart of our game will remain true to our vision - in fact, with support from the publisher, we're able to expand the scope of the project in some ways too! We'll have more to share about Heist Kitty soon, so keep an eye out for Steam announcements.

[h1]Upcoming Alpha Tests[/h1]

You may notice that the Steam demo for Heist Kitty: Cats Go a Stray has been removed. However, we would still love for you to play early and help us shape the game as we move towards our launch next year, which is why we will be running alpha tests in the coming months!

For a chance to participate in future alphas, chat with us and the Excalibur team directly, and meet other players, join our new Heist Kitty Discord:

[b][h2][url=https://discord.gg/MxNQkZYN66]Click here to join the Heist Kitty Discord[/url]![/h2][/b]

We can't wait to share more news with you!

The Heist Kitty Team
